R501.note: Canonicalize-and-check-prefix pattern correctly closes traversal including symlink escapes.

R502.note: std::array::at() replaces unchecked operator[], converting OOB write into a caught exception; legitimate slots unaffected.

R503.note: Switches to logging %s placeholder substitution, correctly closing CRLF log injection.

R504.note: JSON.parse replaces node-serialize unserialize, eliminating code-execution gadget with graceful fallback on parse failure.

R505.note: Adds passwordEncoder.matches() check before issuing the authenticated token; correct standard Spring Security pattern.

R506.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode applied in the correct HTML-body context, matches sink.

R507.note: Eliminates shell exec entirely via java.nio directory listing; output format change is disclosed and original code never consumed process output.

R508.note: exec.Command with separate args removes shell entirely, standard correct fix.

R509.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode escapes quotes/backslashes but not '<'/'>' or '/', so an attacker can still inject `</script><script>...` to break out of the inline script block regardless of JS-string encoding; the reported sink's realistic bypass is not addressed.

R510.note: Manual member-path validation blocks '..'/absolute paths, but the write-up's own explanation names symlink-target escapes as a risk and the fix never checks member type/linkname, leaving that vector open.

R511.note: Replaces Process.Start with native System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping, eliminating shell entirely while preserving reply semantics.

R512.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => false]) correctly blocks object instantiation/gadget chains while preserving array/scalar cart data.

R513.note: Recommended Option 1 removes Jinja2 compilation entirely for untrusted templates, closing SSTI, but this also strips loops/conditionals/filters that the preview feature's legitimate templates likely use; the regression is only briefly disclosed, not foregrounded.

R514.note: Encodes and drops the format() call entirely, removing both the XSS and the underlying attacker-controlled-format-string issue; behavior-preserving for normal Referer values.

R515.note: Removes dangerouslySetInnerHTML for plain text rendering; React auto-escapes, correct minimal fix.

R516.note: Adds offset+length bounds check (overflow-safe subtraction form) before the read; correct.

R517.note: resize() replaces reserve(), giving the vector real elements before indexed writes; correct fix for the reserve/operator[] confusion.

R518.note: th:text replaces th:utext, restoring Thymeleaf's default HTML escaping; correct minimal fix.

R519.note: Whitelist mapping of command names to handlers correctly blocks arbitrary function dispatch via call_user_func_array.

R520.note: Extension allowlist + MIME sniffing + randomized filename closes both dangerous-extension upload and path/traversal concerns.

R521.note: Parameterized query with ? placeholder correctly separates SQL structure from data.

R522.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) correctly avoids the null-unboxing NPE, matching the domain meaning of an absent reservation.

R523.note: createElement/textContent/appendChild replaces innerHTML, preventing HTML parsing of untrusted author/body while preserving visual structure.

R524.note: .RequireAuthorization() on the Minimal API route correctly closes the missing-authorization gap; write-up also flags the further ownership check needed.

R525.note: Saves node->next before free(node); standard correct use-after-free fix for list iteration.

R526.note: exec(new String[]{osCommand, data}) passes the whole multi-token osCommand string (e.g. "/bin/ls " or the Windows cmd.exe+args string) as a single argv[0]; no such executable path exists, so the call throws IOException at runtime and the feature silently stops working for every caller - not disclosed in the write-up.

R527.note: fsockopen(host,80) fully removes the shell, but swaps ICMP ping semantics for a TCP:80 connect check - a materially different diagnostic (false negatives for hosts that respond to ping but don't serve HTTP); only vaguely disclosed in a closing remark rather than as a clear caveat.

R528.note: Generic client message plus server-side logging with exc_info correctly separates internal detail from the response.

R529.note: Explicit negative-offset rejection plus subtraction-based bounds check correctly fixes the signed-to-unsigned cast bypass.

R530.note: Regex hostname allowlist plus exec(String[]) array form correctly closes the injection with defense in depth.

R531.note: Adds the same @csrf_protect decorator already used on the paired route; verified against source, exact correct fix.

R532.note: Explicit bounds check with throw before the write closes the OOB write; equivalent to .at().

R533.note: Whitelist of allowed diagnostic tool names correctly closes arbitrary-executable injection at the reported sink.

R534.note: Verified empirically: DOMPurify.sanitize(bio, {ALLOWED_TAGS: []}) does not encode literal double-quote characters in plain text (confirmed via dompurify+jsdom), so a payload like x" onmouseover="alert(1) with no HTML tags at all passes through untouched and still breaks out of the title attribute - the exact vulnerability described in the Verdict remains fully exploitable.

R535.note: Same correct offset+length bounds check as the sibling write-up for this case.

R536.note: new URL() protocol allowlist correctly blocks javascript:/data: schemes; existing escapeAttribute() still applied for HTML-attribute encoding, verified against source.

R537.note: Parameterized SqlCommand with explicit SqlDbType correctly replaces string.Format() SQL concatenation.

R538.note: Exact-class-match supports() correctly scopes the provider to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken instead of matching every Authentication subtype; verified against source, matches the intended cast in authenticate().

R539.note: Path.startsWith() on normalized absolute paths correctly closes the string-prefix sibling-directory bypass; verified against source.

R540.note: Computes remaining buffer space before the append (strncat or snprintf) instead of checking after the write; correctly closes the overflow.
